find: i += open; // unmatched: literal text, left exactly as written
replace:
for (let k = i; k < chars.length; k += 1) if (chars[k] !== '\n') chars[k] = ' ';
      break;
why: The over-correction #416 invited and this change deliberately refused: treating an unmatched backtick as an open span and blanking the rest of the body. CommonMark says a backtick run with no equal-length closer is literal text, so this would make the parser disagree with how GitHub renders the body it is reading, and would silently DROP real parent mirrors that merely happen to sit after a stray backtick. Pins the decision, not just the code.
killedBy: native relationship contract does not let a code span cross a blank line, the way a paragraph break does not (issue #416)
native relationship contract treats an UNMATCHED backtick as literal text, not as an open span (issue #416)
